Summary: 


```{r}
library(here)
library(vroom)
library(tidyverse)
library(data.table)
library(broom)
source(here("code", "helpers.R"))
```

```{r}
numident <- vroom(here("data", "censoc_numident_w_initials.csv"), col_select = c("HISTID", "middle_A", "middle_B", "race_first", "byear", "INCWAGE", "death_age", "SEX", "EDUC", "RACE", "RELATE", "MARST", "SEI", "link_abe_exact_conservative"), progress = T) %>% 
  janitor::clean_names()
```




```{r}
## Select First letter of middle name (census)
numident$middle_name_census <- get_first_letter_lower(numident$middle_a)

numident$middle_name_numident <- get_first_letter_lower(numident$middle_b)

```



```{r}
numident %>% 
  summarize(mean(!is.na(middle_name_numident)),
            mean(!is.na(middle_name_census)),
            mean(!is.na(middle_name_census) & !is.na(middle_name_numident)))
```

```{r}
censoc_numident_middle <- numident %>% 
  filter(sex == 1) %>% 
  filter(!is.na(middle_name_census) & !is.na(middle_name_numident))


censoc_numident_middle <- censoc_numident_middle %>% 
  mutate(agreement = case_when(
    middle_name_census == middle_name_numident ~ 1,
    TRUE ~ 0))

censoc_numident_middle <- censoc_numident_middle %>% 
  recode_education(educ_var = 'educ')
```



```{r}
censoc_numident_middle
```




```{r}
standard <- censoc_numident_middle %>% 
  filter(byear %in% 1900:1920)

conservative <- censoc_numident_middle %>% 
  filter(link_abe_exact_conservative == 1) %>% 
  filter(byear %in% 1900:1920)

standard_not_conservative <- censoc_numident_middle %>% 
  filter(link_abe_exact_conservative == 0) %>% 
  filter(byear %in% 1900:1920)

education_standard <- standard %>% 
  group_by(agreement) %>%
  do(fitHour = tidy(lm(death_age ~ educ_yrs + as.factor(byear), data = .))) %>% 
  unnest(fitHour) %>% 
  mutate(method = "standard")

education_conservative <- conservative %>% 
  group_by(agreement) %>%
  do(fitHour = tidy(lm(death_age ~ educ_yrs + as.factor(byear), data = .))) %>% 
  unnest(fitHour) %>% 
  mutate(method = "conservative")

education_standard_conservative <- standard_not_conservative %>% 
  group_by(agreement) %>%
  do(fitHour = tidy(lm(death_age ~ educ_yrs + as.factor(byear), data = .))) %>% 
  unnest(fitHour) %>% 
  mutate(method = "standard, not conservative")

education_pooled_standard <- tidy(lm(death_age ~ educ_yrs + as.factor(byear), standard)) %>% 
  mutate(method = "standard") 

education_pooled_conservative <- tidy(lm(death_age ~ educ_yrs + as.factor(byear), conservative)) %>% 
  mutate(method = "conservative")

education_pooled_standard_noconservative <- tidy(lm(death_age ~ educ_yrs + as.factor(byear), standard_not_conservative)) %>% 
  mutate(method = "standard, not conservative")

association_between_educ_and_longevity <- education_standard %>%  
  bind_rows(education_conservative) %>% 
  bind_rows(education_standard_conservative) %>% 
  bind_rows(education_pooled_standard) %>% 
  bind_rows(education_pooled_conservative) %>% 
  bind_rows(education_pooled_standard_noconservative) %>% 
  mutate(agreement = as.factor(agreement)) %>% 
  filter(term == "educ_yrs") %>% 
  mutate(agreement = case_when(
    agreement == 1 ~ "Agree",
    agreement == 0 ~"Disagree",
    TRUE ~ "Pooled")) %>% 
  ggplot(aes(x = method,
             y = estimate, 
             ymin = estimate - 1.96 * std.error,
             ymax = estimate + 1.96*std.error,
             color = agreement,
             shape = agreement)) + 
  geom_pointrange(position = position_dodge(0.1), fill = "white", size = 1) + 
  scale_color_manual(values = cud) + 
  scale_shape_manual(values = c("Agree" = 21, "Disagree" = 22, "Pooled" = 23)) + 
  cowplot::theme_cowplot() + 
  theme(legend.position = "bottom") + 
  ylim(0, 0.15) + 
  labs(x = "Match Method",
       y = "Regression coefficient",
       col = "Middle Initial Agreement",
       shape = "Middle Initial Agreement")

## save plot 
ggsave(association_between_educ_and_longevity, filename = here("figures", "numident_association_between_educ_and_longevity.png"), bg = "white", height = 5, width = 6.5)
```




```{r}
# Define dataset by linking method
standard <- censoc_numident_middle %>%
  filter(byear %in% 1900:1920)

conservative <- standard %>%
  filter(link_abe_exact_conservative == 1)

non_conservative <- standard %>%
  filter(link_abe_exact_conservative == 0)

summarize_passing <- function(df, method_name) {
  # Calculate by agreement
  by_agreement <- df %>%
    filter(race == 200) %>%
    mutate(passing = race_first == 1) %>%
    group_by(agreement) %>%
    summarize(
      mean = mean(passing, na.rm = TRUE),
      se = sqrt(mean * (1 - mean) / sum(!is.na(passing))),
      method = method_name,
      .groups = "drop"
    )
  
  # Add pooled
  pooled <- df %>%
    filter(race == 200) %>%
    mutate(passing = race_first == 1) %>%
    summarize(
      mean = mean(passing, na.rm = TRUE),
      se = sqrt(mean * (1 - mean) / sum(!is.na(passing))),
      method = method_name,
      agreement = NA
    )
  
  bind_rows(by_agreement, pooled)
}
# Apply to each linking method
pass1 <- summarize_passing(conservative, "Conservative")
pass2 <- summarize_passing(non_conservative, "Standard, not Conservative")
pass3 <- summarize_passing(standard, "Standard")

# Combine
passing_rates <- bind_rows(pass1, pass2, pass3) %>%
  mutate(
    agreement = case_when(
      agreement == 1 ~ "Agree",
      agreement == 0 ~ "Disagree",
      TRUE ~ "Pooled"
    )
  )

# Plot
passing_fig <- passing_rates %>%
  ggplot(aes(
    x = method,
    y = mean,
    ymin = mean - 1.96 * se,
    ymax = mean + 1.96 * se,
    color = agreement,
    shape = agreement
  )) +
  geom_pointrange(position = position_dodge(width = 0.1), size = 1, fill = "white") +
  scale_color_manual(values = cud) +
  scale_shape_manual(values = c("Agree" = 21, "Disagree" = 22, "Pooled" = 23)) +
  cowplot::theme_cowplot() +
  theme(legend.position = "bottom") +
  labs(
    x = "Match Method",
    y = "Rate of Passing (Black → White)",
    title = "Rates of Apparent Racial Passing Among Black Men",
    subtitle = "CenSoc-Numident, Birth cohorts 1900–1920",
    color = "Middle Initial Agreement",
    shape = "Middle Initial Agreement"
  ) #+ 
 # ylim(0, NA)

# Save
ggsave(passing_fig, filename = here("figures", "numident_passing_rates.png"), height = 6, width = 8.5, bg = "white")
```



```{r}

summarize_passing <- function(df, method_name) {
  # Calculate by agreement
  by_agreement <- df %>%
    filter(race == 100) %>%
    mutate(passing = race_first == 1) %>%
    group_by(agreement) %>%
    summarize(
      mean = mean(passing, na.rm = TRUE),
      se = sqrt(mean * (1 - mean) / sum(!is.na(passing))),
      method = method_name,
      .groups = "drop"
    )
  
  # Add pooled
  pooled <- df %>%
    filter(race == 100) %>%
    mutate(passing = race_first == 1) %>%
    summarize(
      mean = mean(passing, na.rm = TRUE),
      se = sqrt(mean * (1 - mean) / sum(!is.na(passing))),
      method = method_name,
      agreement = NA
    )
  
  bind_rows(by_agreement, pooled)
}
# Apply to each linking method
pass1 <- summarize_passing(conservative, "Conservative")
pass2 <- summarize_passing(non_conservative, "Standard, not Conservative")
pass3 <- summarize_passing(standard, "Standard")

# Combine
passing_rates <- bind_rows(pass1, pass2, pass3) %>%
  mutate(
    agreement = case_when(
      agreement == 1 ~ "Agree",
      agreement == 0 ~ "Disagree",
      TRUE ~ "Pooled"
    )
  )

# Plot
passing_fig <- passing_rates %>%
  ggplot(aes(
    x = method,
    y = mean,
    ymin = mean - 1.96 * se,
    ymax = mean + 1.96 * se,
    color = agreement,
    shape = agreement
  )) +
  geom_pointrange(position = position_dodge(width = 0.1), size = 1, fill = "white") +
  scale_color_manual(values = cud) +
  scale_shape_manual(values = c("Agree" = 21, "Disagree" = 22, "Pooled" = 23)) +
  cowplot::theme_cowplot() +
  theme(legend.position = "bottom") +
  labs(
    x = "Match Method",
    y = "Rate of Stability (White → White)",
    color = "Middle Initial Agreement",
    shape = "Middle Initial Agreement"
  ) #+ 
 # ylim(0, NA)

# Save
ggsave(passing_fig, filename = here("figures", "numident_stability_rates.png"), height = 6, width = 8.5, bg = "white")
```
